content:wysiwyg_basic:1786032763291:0.09.html:
Angel Tree Program in Greenville County, SC

Every child deserves to experience the joy of Christmas morning. The Salvation Army of Greenville Angel Tree program, in collaboration with Toys for Tots, helps provide Christmas gifts for thousands of children in our community each year. Once a child has been registered and accepted as an Angel, their Christmas wish list is shared with donors in our area who purchase gifts of new clothing and toys. The gifts are distributed to the family to place under their family Christmas Tree.

You can make a difference in Greenville. Check back soon for how to adopt an Angel.
